Filmmaker · Actor · Storyteller

AboutMe

I am a Moody Honors student at The University of Texas, majoring in Radio-Television-Film. I am an actor, video editor, videographer, photographer, and director. I've worked on large-scale productions to smaller, independent projects. I discovered my passion for filmmaking through YouTube at the age of 11, and have since dedicated myself to honing my craft, ultimately guiding me to UT Austin to further follow my love for storytelling and the art of filmmaking.
